description: Generates and verifies repo-local AGENTS.md guidance plus Codex facing skill adapter docs, procedure docs, and deterministic handoff validation for Quoin workflow use in Codex. Does not install global Codex paths or command files.

portable_inputs.description: Portable skill names and effort values — referenced by name, not duplicated inline
Portable per-skill workflow contracts used by generated Codex skill adapter docs
Portable contracts grounded by the Codex workflow execution procedures
Portable session-state contract grounded by the Codex handoff procedure and validator
Portable task-layout contract used to resolve Codex handoff task paths
Portable cost-event schema and row parser used by the Codex cost writer
Portable ledger row contract used by Codex cost validation

generated_outputs.description: Codex repo instructions for Quoin workflow phases and .workflow_artifacts/ layout
Codex facing adapter doc for each portable skill; references the portable core contract and documents unsupported Claude-only translations
Index of Codex facing skill adapter docs generated from portable skill metadata
Shared unsupported-translation notes for Claude-only runtime behavior
Repo-local Codex workflow execution guide for discover, plan, implement, review, and gate
Per-phase Codex procedures linked to portable core skill contracts
Codex repo-local session handoff procedure for .workflow_artifacts/memory/sessions/
Deterministic checker for Codex handoff markdown shape and repo-local artifact paths
Codex cost event behavior and explicit unavailable telemetry contract
Repo-local Codex cost event writer/checker using the portable cost core

unsupported_outputs.name: global Codex install
unsupported_outputs.reason: Global Codex install paths and package registry behavior are unresolved until a stable extension point is verified

unsupported_outputs.name: Codex command files
unsupported_outputs.reason: Codex command file format and discovery mechanism are not yet confirmed

unsupported_outputs.name: approval or sandbox logic
unsupported_outputs.reason: Use Codex native approval and sandboxing; Quoin must not duplicate these

validation.notes: Run from the repository root. The readiness check verifies repo-local Codex setup evidence only; it does not inspect or write global Codex locations.
